subject: getting RMark to run on a Mac

messages.author: f8113e402b0f8158
messages.subject: getting RMark to run on a Mac
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to get Mark to run on a mac (OS Sierra, 10.12.6) using RMark and running into some stumbling blocks.

I have the mark executable (mark) in a local directory on my computer. If I navigate to that directory in the terminal and run ./mark, I get the following "No input file was specified, so MARK job is done // STOP No input file", which I think means it's installed correctly. At the start of my R script, before I load RMark, I set the MarkPath so RMark can find mark and when I load RMark, it says "This is RMark 2.2.4
 Documentation available at http://www.phidot.org/software/mark/rmark/RMarkDocumentation.zip."

When I try to run a model using mark from the examples in the RMark documentation, however, I get this error:

sh: mark: command not found
Error in run.mark.model(model, invisible = invisible, adjust = adjust,  :
 
Output file does not exist. Unable to find or run mark.exe

Anyone use RMark on a mac and have thoughts on what to try next? I tried installing gfortran, as suggested here, http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=21&t=3233.

Thanks for any thoughts!

--Allison


--
Allison Dedrick
Graduate Group in Ecology
University of California, Davis

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: getting RMark to run on a Mac
parts: I had similar frustrations installing on a Mac and eventually went with VirtualBox/Parallels to run Windows on my Mac for MARK.  My hunch is that it's the equivalent of a Windows PATH issue for where R is looking for the mark.exe file, but I don't have much insight other than that, sorry!
